ranking.name: Calcasieu - Private Dining by Chef Donald Link

text.text_excerpt: I visited the Calcasieu Room last night to attend a wine dinner with german food/Rudi Weist wines for NOWFE. I was very impressed with the decor and ambiance of the room. It is very clean, and the view is spectacular. We had around 25 people at the dinner, and we sat at one long table in the middle of the main room. The Good: The plates for the dishes were warmed/chilled according to the dish on them. A big plus. Food was fantastic, and needless to say, I'm very impressed with Link/Stryjewsky's German cuisine. The wines were impeccable (not that this is to the credit of Calcasieu), but the stemware was cleaned properly and paired properly. Hugely important for a wine dinner. The wine pour...

Uh - this place is awesome! Came here for a doctor-talk paid for by the peeps who own our hospital. Thank you very much! I probably wouldn't have a good reason to come here otherwise. After eating at Cochon a few times, my expectations for delicious food were quite high. The catering did not disappoint. The salads all came together, the entrees were served family style, and the dessert was warm and fresh. The bf (came for moral and co-dining support) made a passing comment about not eating gluten while apps were going around. BAM- they gave him gluten free dessert without even mentioning it to him or making a fuss. That's high quality service right there. The portion on the drinks were al...

I was excited when I found out a rehearsal dinner I was going to was at Cochon because I knew the food would be outstanding. The private Calcasieu room is located just upstairs from Cochon. There was a private bar ready for slinging drinks and the bartender was friendly and quick, never letting a line build up. At this particular dinner, it was set up buffet style. The buffet line was sectioned off from the dining area which was nice because it kept things organized and less chaotic. The big round tables sat anywhere between 8-10 people.
